deadline.value: Priority PhD deadline December 1; later applications considered on a space-available basis through April 1.
deadline.quote: Priority Ph.D. application deadline is December 1.

fee_waiver.value: A referral code waives the fee for domestic PhD applicants; nothing is said about international waivers.

gre_general.value: GRE is highly recommended; applications may be considered without it, but the committee may request scores.
gre_general.quote: scores are highly recommended for the BME graduate program

gre_subject.value: The department does not mention a subject test.

toefl_min.value: Department expects a composite TOEFL iBT of at least 90 (above the university minimum of 80); below 100 may require English classes.
toefl_min.quote: International students should have a minimum composite TOEFL score of 90 on the internet-based test.

ielts_min.value: Department accepts a minimum IELTS of 7.5 (or Duolingo 125) in place of TOEFL.
ielts_min.quote: The Department will also accept a minimum 7.5 IELTS score or 125 DUOLINGO score in lieu of the TOEFL.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty directly about research and funding, though the admissions committee does not place students in labs.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to contact faculty members directly at the e-mail addresses shown on their web pages in order to seek out potential research projects and to explore avenues of funding.

funding.value: Most PhD students are supported by individual faculty as research assistants; a few competitive fellowships exist.
funding.quote: Most Biomedical Engineering Ph.D. students are supported by individual faculty members as Research Assistants.

entry_route.value: Exceptionally qualified B.S. students are encouraged to apply directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: we encourage exceptionally qualified B.S. students to apply for direct admission to our Ph.D. program
